title: Uralic languages - Wikipedia
text: The Uralic languages (/ jʊəˈrælɪk / yoor-AL-ik), sometimes called the Uralian languages (/ jʊəˈreɪliən / yoor-AY-lee-ən), [3] are spoken predominantly in Europe and North Asia. The Uralic languages with the most native speakers are Hungarian, Finnish, and Estonian. Other languages with over 100,000 speakers are Erzya, Moksha, Mari, Udmurt and Komi spoken in European Russia.
